name: Tsuchimikado Youka
source:
Third year student of "Sun Academy". She's the vice president of the student council and one of this year candidate for μ. 

[spoiler]She's actually really envious of Natsuhi Hikaru and planning together with Sister Sisley to become this year's μ. [/spoiler]
